name: @sundial/dsh-sensors
description: Cordis plugin: Gnomon's sensors inside dsh. Polls the Swift sidecar JSON files (never spawning TCC-gated processes), cross-wires git/shell/project detection, appends every reading through gnomonKernel.appendSignal, and hosts the loopback phone-ingest listener on 127.0.0.1:8767.
